subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): generic outbound delivery-report seam; WhatsApp native auto-reply reports provider-accepted sends

question: Should OpenClaw accept `openclaw/plugin-sdk/outbound-delivery-report` as the public contract for channel self-delivery reports, and with this idempotency/session-key shape?
rationale: The patch exposes a new release-facing Plugin SDK subpath; automation can review implementation details, but only maintainers can decide the long-term public API contract.

options.title: Approve seam after proof
options.body: Require redacted real WhatsApp/runtime proof, then merge this generic SDK seam if maintainers accept the current naming and idempotency contract.

options.title: Revise API shape first
options.body: Keep the PR open but ask for a narrower or renamed SDK contract before external plugins can depend on it.

options.title: Pause the branch
options.body: Keep the linked issue as the design point and pause or close this PR if maintainers are not ready to own a public delivery-report API.

recommendation.title: Approve seam after proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted real WhatsApp/runtime proof, then merge this generic SDK seam if maintainers accept the current naming and idempotency contract.
